payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the NER model incorporates both text and images for named entity recognition, specifically through a multimodal approach.

claims.text: The NER model learns from both text and images by using a hybrid multimodal network that combines visual and textual information.
The proposed model significantly outperforms traditional text-only NER models by effectively leveraging visual contexts alongside textual data.
The modality attention module in the model selectively integrates information from both modalities to enhance entity recognition.
